Clara Bell: quick heads-up 1: setting up a hands-on SI field lab for two integrators next month. need to lock down hardware handoff and marketplace listing checklist.
Ethan Morales: which partners? have we confirmed the A100 devkits and Gen2 instances?
Clara Bell: partners are Meridian SI and NorthStar Integrations. Meridian requested A100 40GB test units, NorthStar wants RTX 6000 series. both need marketplace SKU mapping for BYO billing.
Priya Shah: noted. i'll prepare SKU mapping and a short billing flow for the marketplace (15m). can you confirm whether listing will be private or public initially?
Clara Bell: private for first 90 days, then public. also want a certification mini-track: lab hands-on + short eval (pass/fail). target completion window = 2 weeks post-lab.
Ethan Morales: infra checklist: VPN peering, sandbox subnet, security group rules (open 8443, 22 for ops, and 10250 for kube). OnboardingBot can auto-create RBAC roles for integrator accounts.
OnboardingBot: ACTION: automatic RBAC role creation scheduled when Clara uploads partner list to Confluence. See https://confluence.redwood.ai/partners/field-labs for details.
Clara Bell: draft agenda for the lab day:
- 09:00 intro + expectations
- 09:15 hardware handoff + safety briefing
- 10:00 environment teardown & test image walkthrough
- 11:00 live integration exercise (deploy model, run perf tests)
- 12:00 lunch
- 13:00 marketplace listing walkthrough + billing mapping
- 14:00 certification exam (30m)
- 14:40 retrospective + next steps
Ethan Morales: i'll open ticket INFRA-4789 for sandbox prep and link the security playbook.
Priya Shah: i'll build the marketplace deck and include sample SKU table and invoice flow. ETA: EOD Friday.
Clara Bell: perfect. next steps: (1) Ethan: INFRA-4789 + provisioning (2) Priya: SKU mapping + deck (3) Clara: invite + partner list upload. please react with :white_check_mark: when done.
Ethan Morales: :white_check_mark:
Priya Shah: :white_check_mark:
OnboardingBot: Reminder will send 72h before lab with provisioning checklist and access links.
Clara Bell: thanks team. we'll iterate on the certification rubric after the first run and capture notes in the partner playbook.
